name: @vyre/desktop
description: The Vyre desktop shell (Tauri 2). The system webview loads the Expo web build; the vyred device daemon runs beside it as a sidecar (ARCH 5.10, 7.13, R13).

scripts.web: cd ../app && npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist
scripts.build: npm run web && npm run stage && npm run tauri -- build --ci
scripts.dev: npm run stage && npm run tauri -- dev
